Format
Project case study
The work

From problem to system.

The problem

Pregnancy and early parenthood information is often scattered across different tools, making it harder to follow guidance for a specific stage.

The approach

The React Native project organizes pregnancy weeks, trimester topics, postpartum recovery, and toddler guidance in one mobile experience. Its repository documents email OTP authentication and video integration.

01
Follow each stage

Week-by-week and trimester screens organize pregnancy information.

02
Continue after birth

Postpartum and toddler modules extend the experience beyond pregnancy.

03
Connect the product

Authentication and video content are part of the documented app architecture.

Abdullah’s role was full stack AI & cloud engineer. This is a collaborative project; specific AI or cloud services and individual implementation contributions are not described in the public README.
